title: sigterm() duplicated verbatim in reader and transit main.rs
description:
The sigterm() async function is copy-pasted identically in:
  crates/reader/src/main.rs (line 434)
  crates/transit/src/main.rs (line 1015)

Both are identical: register SIGTERM handler, await first signal.

If signal handling ever changes (e.g., SIGHUP for config reload, or
extended to a broader signal set), both copies must be updated in sync.
Maintenance hazard with no engineering justification for the duplication.

Move to usenet-ipfs-core or a shared internal utility and import from
both binaries.
